name: etiquetas-colineal
description: Etiquetas Colineal — monorepo: apps/api (Express :3010) + apps/web (React/Vite :3000) + impresión vía QZ Tray

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev --workspace=apps/api" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/web"
scripts.start: cross-env NODE_ENV=production concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run start --workspace=apps/api" "npm run start --workspace=apps/web"
scripts.preview: npm run build && npm run start
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/web
